title: pedicularis stenocorys var. pseudostenocorys
intro: Pedicularis stenocorys var. pseudostenocorys, commonly known as  Fox's Lopseed, is a plant species in the family Orobanchaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Pedicularis stenocorys var. pseudostenocorys include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitussive properties, which can help alleviate respiratory problems, such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as stenocoryine and pseudostenocoryine, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects.
